# Aeluma to Announce First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on November 12, 2026


October 29, 2026 7:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_8121b3ab1271a8877ea2ae510d5ccaa7/aeluma/news/2026-10-29_Aeluma_to_Announce_First_Quarter_Fiscal_Year_2027__117.pdf)


GOLETA, Calif., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aeluma, Inc. (NASDAQ: ALMU), a semiconductor company specializing in high-performance, scalable technologies for mobile, AI, defense and aerospace, robotics, automotive, AR/VR, and quantum, today announced it will issue its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, which ended September 30, 2026, after the U.S. financial markets close on Thursday, November 12, 2026.


That same day, Aeluma will host a conference call at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time / 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss the Company’s financial results and business outlook. Interested participants may access the call by dialing (833) 890-6767 (domestic) or (412) 564-6155 (international) and referencing “Aeluma”.


A live webcast of the call will also be available on the[“Investors” section](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=MpJEOPqj-qmw9Yjxkbf25e4Hf5W6rI4-i9CNM-tUK1GT4iCD15ITln0EgdW8IYVr8I-dkaSXjt1GoDqjDpM-IHCjiL9-WXPFwHR3dXH5TyVvRr9-8yT6SaRnMAn7YviB) of Aeluma’s website. The live webcast can also be accessed by clicking[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iF8lmdWAzslspip9sE9sGrdMBWR2nDQU_lsxh_l3JqNCYbU0vY2DTwY8c_w3yzSONo29Lj97LzmJrPl63Y-HFfivSzbcuRypL-xrKDhY8VEKkkdf25JHoxsU6cglEBUnpcyPcrvtu_f9cTic3uKyYA==) . A replay of the conference call will be available on Aeluma’s website shortly after the call concludes.


**About Aeluma**


Aeluma (NASDAQ: ALMU) is a transformative semiconductor company specializing in high-performance photonic and electronic technologies that scale. The company’s proprietary platform combines compound semiconductors with scalable manufacturing used for mass market microelectronics to enable volume production and large-scale integration. Applications for Aeluma’s technology include mobile, AI, defense and aerospace, robotics, automotive, AR/VR, and quantum. Headquartered in Goleta, California, Aeluma operates state-of-the-art R&D and manufacturing capabilities for semiconductor wafer production, quick-turn chip fabrication, rapid prototyping, test and validation. Aeluma also partners with production-scale fabrication foundries, packaging, and integration companies.
